notes.title: Hotfix 0.1.1-EarlyAccess+159798
notes.notes:
Hi Funguys,



We’re addressing some of the feedback and bugs found by the community in this update.



Community Feedback Changes:

Winning a Run no longer removes your current Fire Curse (THE FIRE KING THANKS YOU FOR YOUR LOYALTY).

Rerolling Skills and Mutations can no longer show the same option.



Bugs You Helped Us Catch:

Fixed rerolling Dew at max level resulting in a blank Skill Card offer.

Fixed equipped Pet icon sometimes not appearing correctly.

Fixed Keybind Hint sometimes not appearing correctly.

Fixed Douse Dew quest appearing when the player has no Fire Curse.

Fixed Chestnut from Elites sometimes dropping inside a building.

Fixed Soulboom: Sweet Release not dealing damage on dash.

Fixed inability to move the cursor in the Shroomshop when using a controller.

Fixed locking Dew at max level resulting in a UI softlock.


General Bug Fixes:

Fixed various VFX & SFX issues.

Fixed various UI issues.



✨ Thanks to all your feedback and bug reports, Funguys Swarm keeps getting better with every update. Keep the feedback coming — together we’ll keep making the game even juicier! 🍄💥

— Stairway Games

notes.title: Hotfix-0.1.5-Demo Version
notes.notes:
Hi Funguys!



We're releasing another hotfix with various improvements and fix some bugs in the demo.

We’re incredibly grateful for your thoughtful feedback, and we hope this hotfix shall help you rise against the Fire King's Army!


[hr][/hr]Improvements
Reroll is now bound to the Y button on controller.

When revived in combat, the player now returns with a full heart (instead of just 1 heart).

Improved Level Selection UI: future game modes no longer display by default — you can now switch between available modes using a button. (More modes coming soon!)


Bugfixes
Fixed various localization and button prompt errors.

Fixed the Splash Shot damage calculation error introduced by the Shatter rework.

Fixed an issue where enemies could become invulnerable when afflicted with both Freeze and Flat status effects.


Best,

Stairway Team

notes.title: Hotfix-0.1.4-Demo Version
notes.notes:
Hi Funguys!



Steam Next Fest is over, thank you SO much for playing and sending in your feedback!

We’ve just dropped the 0.1.4-Demo Version update to address some of the things you've pointed out. Here’s what’s new:

Skill and Passive cards are now back to have 7 levels instead of 10! 

Mutations appear at level 4 and 7. This means faster pacing, more meaningful upgrades, and more importantly, you get to pick more Mutations per run!

(NEW) Rerolls! By popular demand, you can now unlock Reroll Tokens from Starpath that will give you 3 Reroll Tokens every time you go to the Carrot Farm. More Reroll Tokens and variations will be available in Early Access!

The Skills Info panel can now be closed by pressing again TAB on the keyboard or Select button on the controller.

 
[hr][/hr]Balancing
General:

Reduced Dash Cooldown from 7.5s to 6s.

Slightly increase the chance of health drops to spawn.

Skills:

Manafall

Fixed Manafall sometimes does not target the right enemies.

Fixed Manafall Crystals now get destroyed by enemies' attacks (such as projectiles and explosives).

Repulsive Shock

Changed Unstable Garlic mutation now does not also reduce the radius, instead it now always temporarily increases the radius while radiating before returning to the original radius.

Thunder Spear

Fixed Thunder Spear sometimes spawns attached to the player even when there are no mutations taken.

Enemies

Reduced Carrot Farm 3rd elite HP from 16K to 14K.

Reduced Appletini HP from 46K to 42K.


Best,

Stairway Team

notes.title: Hotfix-0.1.2-Demo Version+149449
notes.notes:
Hi Funguys!

We’ve released a hotfix to address some bugs and improve the music in the demo.
Thank you all so much for trying out the Funguys Swarm demo! 
If you run into any bugs or have feedback to share, feel free to reach out on our Discord: discord.gg/stairway or Steam Discussions.


Bugfixes:

 Fixed description and localization issues
 Fixed buttons sometimes appearing too small
 Fixed radar lines pointing to encounters remaining after the encounter ends
 Fixed FPS settings not being applied correctly in some cases
 Fixed controller interaction issues
 Fixed cooldown not displaying correctly in the Skill Badge UI
 Fixed intro movie music not playing correctly in some cases


Improvements:

 Pause Menu now has background music.
 Carrot Farm has two different songs.


Thanks,
Stairway Team

notes.title: Hotfix-v0.1.2
notes.notes:
Hi Funguys,

Thank you so much for all the amazing feedback you’ve shared! We’ve been watching you dive into the fiery swarms, and it’s been a blast!

We’ve cooked up a hotfix based on what we’ve seen and heard to help make Funguys Swarm even better. Keep the feedback coming, you can drop it on our Steam discussions, hop into our Discord, or tag us on social media!

Thanks again for playing the Funguys Swarm demo, we hope you're having as much fun [strike]dying to the swarm[/strike] beating the Appletini!

Added new Skills:
Grape Barrage: Your Grape weapon now throws an extra projectile.
[hr][/hr]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505085/8442f5cdcd500eb81e2797ce2c4f888a4aae5590.png

Thunderspear: After a number of attacks, you spawn spears in front of you that stab enemies.
[hr][/hr]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505085/aaf4ff4a59984935b2a76878e776906b2403e285.png

Gameplay Changes:

 New skill progression: start with 2 skill slots, unlock 2 more every 10 levels, up to 6 total.
 Skills now mutate at level 5 and level 10 (was level 4 and 7).
 Passive cards reworked:

 No longer upgradeable to Fire Level.
 Can now level up to 10 (increased overall effects).

 Hot Coal (Fire Skill) temporarily removed.
 New icons for different Auto-Attack states.
 Adjusted XP bean color variations.
 Appletini now enters Rage Mode at 50% health.


Bugfixes:

 Enemies now correctly move around Manafall crystals.
 Auto-Aim system now correctly targets fire totems and special clutters.
 Fixed special clutters not showing health bar when damaged.
 Fixed Auto-Attack delay when an enemy enters attack range.


Balancing: 

Stand In Circle challenge duration reduced:

Normal: 30s → 25s
Hard: 20s → 15s 

 Power-up durations (Haste, Amplify Damage, Invulnerability, Resources) reduced to 20s at max level.
 Changed Encounter and Swarm timings for Carrot Farm
 Balanced enemy health and movement speed


Skills:
Stardust

Projectile amount: 4–6 → 4
XP drop chance: 10% → 1%–5%
TWINKLE STARS spawn chance: 5% → 1%
SPLITTING BOLTS damage: 60% → 55%


Splash Shot

Damage: 16–22 → 18–26
Spawn amount: 1–3 → 1–5 projectiles


Soulboom

HERD HUNT AoE: 200 → 250
PRICKLY REACTION AoE: 400 → 600


Thunder Strike

ELECTRIC LEAPS radius: 400 → 450
ELECTRIC LEAPS now deals reduced damage on each leap
STORMCALL now strikes 2 additional targets


Boomshroom

 DOUBLE TRIGGER chance: 20% → 25%
 SEED OF DESTRUCTION now uses pseudo-roll


Manafall

 Damage: 18–30 → 20–30
 Amount: 1 → 2–4
 Projectile Range: 1000–1600 → 1200–1600
 Cooldown: 13s–11s → 10s
 STAR LINK rework:

No longer gives projectile damage reduction or extra amount
Now deals 25% of the projectile damage as laser
Applies slow if NULLFIELD is also taken

IMPACT POINT:

Pull range: 400 → 800
Pull duration: 0.5s → 0.85s



Boulder Bonk

 Cooldown: 14s–12s → 10s–8s
 Damage: 16–28 → 22–38
 METEORIC SHARD:

Damage: 50% → 65%
Range: 75% → 65%
Reduced visual size

 METEOR CALL: cooldown reduced by 1s per 4 XP beans collected


Iron Shroom

Damage: 16–24 → 14–22
FUNGI SONG damage: 80% → 65% of main damage


Debuffs
Shock

 Increased total damage: ~30 → ~40


Mark

 Explosion damage now scales with the target’s Max HP


Starlight

 Now deals burst damage based on number of hits taken
 If target dies from burst, it drops double XP


Freeze

 Frozen explosive enemies no longer explode


Treelings
Magnetika:

Reduced kill requirements from 800 to 600


Punchy:

Reworked mechanics: it now reduces your weapon range by -20%, your weapon deals extra damage per health missing from the target (max at 20% HP to deal additional +100% damage)


Furiosy:

 Reworked mechanics: it now temporarily increases you attack speed to 80% for 6s (ignore any additional buffs) after every 300 enemies you killed without taking any damage (The count will be reset upon taking damage)


Thanks,
Stairway Team
